value.data: SOBHA Dream Gardens is a large residential project known for its unique Zen-themed architecture and landscaping. It spans 17 acres and offers 1 and 2 BHK apartments.. Configurations: 1 BHK, 2 BHK

Residents generally appreciate Sobha Dream Gardens for its Zen-themed design, extensive amenities, and strategic location with good connectivity. However, there are notable concerns regarding maintenance, construction quality, high costs, and environmental issues such as waste management and foul smells from a nearby dump yard.

data: Zen-themed architecture and landscaping, creating a peaceful environment
Good connectivity and prime location, with easy access to IT parks, major roads, airport, schools, hospitals, and malls
Extensive and well-maintained amenities including clubhouse, swimming pool, gym, landscaped gardens, kids' play area, and 24/7 security
Spacious apartment layouts with good balconies and utility areas
Overall good ambience and reliable basic facilities like water and electricity
